reviews.review:
As a big fan of the Mass Effect series, this game is very disappointing.  It feels mostly like a Mass Effect game with respect to gameplay and aesthetics, but it's just such a frustrating experience to play.  Of the 14 hours I've played so far, it feels like 30% of that time is spent in loading screens and unskippable cutscenes.  There are still random and strange facial expressions from characters that are comically out of place.  There are far too many two-step quests that just have you running back and forth between two areas, with loading screens for every pass.

There is still lots to love.  The scenery and graphics are fantastic.  The music is great.  There's loads of world-building and interactive story and lore explaining objects.  When you're actually doing a nice long mission, the combat and exploration is mostly fun (aside from the hand scanner, which feels obnoxious to keep switching between weapons and a computer ad nauseam).   I want to like this game, I just don't due to how much time is spent waiting and bored.  Everytime I try and play, I just end up annoyed and can't be bothered.

If you love the Mass Effect universe and have some patience, the game could be very enjoyable for you.  It's just not the game for me.

I have been a fan of the Mass Effect Trilogy since it came out, played the games, ME1-3, read about the lore, read some fanfic (ara-ara) and honestly no game has ever meant soo much for me as a gamer as the Mass Effect Trilogy. When the day came that I had the correct equipment to play Mass Effect Andromeda, I have to say it's really well done and a great game. I understand that to some the bugs within the game makes it a tat irritating, but to be honest the gameplay and story line is really mezmerising and really fun in every aspect, it saddens me that some of the olden races from the original Mass Effect's aren't to be found here for example the Quarians and Elcor, and even that Shepard isn't present in this one or even brought to glory for what he did, but still Ryder makes the game interesting and gives rise to enjoying a wild adventure with him/her and their crew across Andromeda. I'll end by saying, Mass Effect Andromeda is really worth playing especially if you had a kind of attachment to the previous games. Ignore the negative comments, invest some time, tweak some GPU settings and trust me, you'll love it, hopefully as much as I do and will)  It's still a Golden Game, haters will hate pfftt

I am glad that a lot of people are giving this game a second chance. I have seen others played it but it sure is a lot more fun to play it myself.

I invested almost two weeks, I had stopped playing the other games I usually play just to play through it all. It is fantastic, sure there are some glitches, bugs and problems that I had encountered. But trust me; give it a try, gameplay is unbelievably fun, character costumization are also amazing, the skill trees and companions are great. It is a shame that this game has not received a much needed sequel

Sure, it does not live up to its name as the "Sequel to the Mass Effect Trilogy", but it sure makes a good standalone game. If it had been referred to as such, it would have sold out for a lot more.

At a big  sale the game is worthy . Everything seems worse than ME3 , but i had a great time with the combat .hard level is the right choice , and no , its not too hard.

Game is a 6/10

Pros :combat/gameplay / variety of planets / a bit of exploration

Neutral:Side quests are not terrible but not engaging

Cons:Repetitive , Meh story , a Tsunami of bugs and glitches , abysmal romance options (lizards, furries, monsters) get Cora !
